nina_se: Heads-up 10AM call with Horizon sec team. They want sample audit events, retention numbers, and how we forward logs to their Splunk/SIEM. POC next week.

omar_sec: I'll prepare a short packet. Map to SIG/CAIQ: admin/audit -> CAIQ.AUD-01, forwarding -> SIG.MON-01, retention -> SIG.RET-01.

nina_se: Can you drop two one-line JSON examples and a curl/snippet for Splunk HEC? Procurement likes copy-paste.

omar_sec: Admin event: {"event_type":"admin_action","ts":"2025-08-21T09:15:02Z","actor":"u_402","action":"update_policy","target":"deployment-7","req":"r_202"} 

omar_sec: Detection event: {"event_type":"detection","ts":"2025-08-21T09:17:10Z","name":"abnormal_admin_activity","sev":"high","count":12} 

ben_ops: Minimal Splunk HEC forwarder (curl): curl -s https://splunk.horizon.local:8088/services/collector -H "Authorization: Splunk <token>" -d @/var/log/redwood/audit.log 

omar_sec: Retention defaults (hosted): API logs 90 days hot / 13 months cold; Admin/audit 1 year default (option to archive to S3 up to 7 years with Object Lock); Auth events 13 months; Inference metrics 90 days. POC: we can hold 6 months if requested.

ben_ops: We support streaming via TLS (HEC/syslog) or S3 export. Customer can provide S3 ARN + KMS key; we write gzipped ndjson and can set Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode for immutability.

omar_sec: One-line security note to paste: "Logs encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customer-managed KMS supported for S3 archival. Audit access is RBAC-restricted and access to logs is itself logged."

ci-bot: POC infra scheduled: horizon-poc at 2025-08-22T02:00:00Z. :white_check_mark: 

nina_se: Thanks 1 will send to procurement with a one-page mapping to SIG/CAIQ and attach the two examples. If they ask for network allowlist/mTLS we'll follow up with IP ranges and mutual TLS options.

omar_sec: If they need formal retention SLA or immutable SLA, mark as Dedicated/Private add-on and loop legal.

nina_se: Sent to buyer at 2025-08-21T10:05:00Z. Marking resolved unless they ask for deeper logs or network details.
